WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Transferor is the owner in fee simple of certain real property, in the City of New Exhibit A attached hereto and made a part hereof (said real property being hereinafter called the "Granting Lot"); WHEREAS, Transferee is the owner of certain parcels of real property designated as Block 700, Lots 48 and 49, as shown on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and more particularly described in Exhibit B attached hereto and made a part hereof (said properties, together with the Zoning lot of which they are or may become a part being hereafter called the “Receiving Lot"); WHEREAS, the Granting Lot is a “granting site,”' as defined in Section 98-33 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York (hereinafter,“"Zoning Resolution"); WHEREAS, the Receiving Lot is a “receiving site,”’ as defined in Section 98-33 of the Zoning Resolution; WHEREAS, pursuant to the provisions of Section 98-33 of the Zoning Resolution, Transferor and Transferee have notified the Department of City Planning of the City of New York (hereinafter, the “DCP") of their intent to transfer Seven Thousand Nine Hundred and One and Fifty Five Tenths (7,901.55) square feet of floor area from the Granting Lot to the Receiving Lot (the “"Transfer Floor Area"); and WHEREAS, Transferor and Transferee desire to transfer the Transfer Floor Area to the Receiving Lot. NOW. THEREFORE, in consideration of ten ($10.00) dollars, lawful money of the United States, and other valuable consideration paid by Transferee:  1. Transferor does hereby grant, distribute and transfer the Transfer Floor Area from the Granting Lot to the Receiving Lot, solely for the use and benefit in perpetuity of the Receiving Lot (and not for the use or benefit of any other lot or parcel of land). Transferor covenants that, in compliance with Section 13 of the Lien Law, it will same first to the payment of the cost of the improvement before using any part of the total of the same for any other purposes.
